name: Comstar Internet
summary: Brisbane dialup + hosting ISP (from ~2002); still active as Comstar Internet, now broadband + domain/web hosting + web design (COMSTAR INTERNET SERVICES PTY LTD).

events.details: Brisbane dialup + hosting; earliest Wayback capture 29 May 2002 (comstar.com.au).

Still trading; comstar.com.au live through 2024-25 offering broadband, domain/web hosting and web design (COMSTAR INTERNET SERVICES P/L, ph 1300 72 82 92). An earlier record claiming 'defunct c.2005' was incorrect — homepage captures run continuously from 2002 to 2025.
